title: Check output
description: What the model returns for a check generation: the possible coherence issues it finds, each backed by quotes.

findings.description: The possible issues, most serious first. Empty when the scenes hold together.

message.description: What does not hold together, in one or two sentences, in the project's language.

evidence.description: The passages that show the issue, at least one.

scene.description: The handle of the scene the quote comes from, such as S4.

quote.description: A passage copied word for word from the scene's text as the context shows it.
